headline: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited: Agreements
sum: Agreements - Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of land parcel in Bandra (East), Mumbai by Fleur Hotels Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company
